//: Copy the paperless entry into your claude_desktop_config.json. Locations: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json, Windows %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json, Linux ~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json. Quit Claude Desktop completely and reopen it afterwards.
//install: Install the published package first: uv tool install paperless-mcp. Every dependency is a stable release, so no resolver flags are needed.
//command: Absolute path to the installed executable — Claude Desktop does not inherit your shell PATH, so a bare 'paperless-mcp' usually fails to resolve. Find it with `command -v paperless-mcp` (macOS/Linux, typically ~/.local/bin/paperless-mcp) or `where paperless-mcp` (Windows).
//uvx: To skip the install and let Claude Desktop run uvx on every launch, use the absolute path to uvx as command and these args instead: ["--from", "paperless-mcp", "paperless-mcp"].
//switches: PAPERLESS_MCP_READONLY=true hides every write and delete tool; PAPERLESS_MCP_ENABLE_DELETE=true adds the delete tools on top of the default read+write set. READONLY always wins.
